title: He got so big, the government chopped him into 34 pieces. He got richer. 🛢️
caption:
Standard Oil was broken up in 1911. Rockefeller's fortune doubled. 💰
Tag the friend who always wins 👇
first_comment: Tag the friend who always lands on their feet 👇
sources: Chernow R. (1998) 'Titan: The Life of John D. Rockefeller, Sr.' (Random House) (rebates from railroads; ~90% of US refining by 1880; dimes; wealth roughly doubled after the breakup)
Standard Oil Co. of New Jersey v. United States, 221 U.S. 1 (1911) (dissolution into 34 companies)
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'Standard Oil Company and Trust' (successors incl. Exxon, Mobil, Chevron); Keppler U. J. (1904) 'Next!' octopus cartoon, Puck
